title: Termination of every log-canonical MMP for Enriques pairs with a primitive Enriques minimal model
author: Francesco Antonio Denisi; Ángel David Ríos Ortiz; Nikolaos Tsakanikas; Zhixin Xie
work: MMP for Enriques pairs and singular Enriques varieties
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique—Mathématiques 13(2026),629-686; DOI10.5802/jep.334; published2026-03-13
difficulty_reason: After the ordinary log-pair, minimal-model and symplectic-cover prerequisites, the authored proof still lifts an arbitrary downstairs MMP to a finite-group-equivariant MMP along a Galois quasi-etale cover and compares that equivariant sequence with a genuine ordinary MMP. It establishes preservation of the primitive symplectic/Enriques class through contractions and flips and transfers ordinary IHS termination to the original Enriques pair, including the claimed singularity and divisor properties of the resulting minimal model. These source-local lifting and termination-comparison arguments are research-level obligations beyond routine doctoral qualifying-exam birational geometry.
